scenarios.scenario_abstract: While building a small everyday wardrobe for school, [X] compares an inexpensive pair of jeans with a much pricier alternative by checking denim weight, stitching, hardware, repeat outfit use, and how soon each is likely to need replacement, rather than treating the label as proof of value.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为学校生活搭建精简日常衣橱时，[X]会对比一条平价牛仔裤和价格高出许多的另一条；判断依据包括牛仔布克重、缝线、五金、能否反复搭配以及预计多久需要更换，而不是把品牌标签直接当成高价值的证明。
examples: paying more only when construction and likely wear justify it
choosing the affordable pair when the quality gap is small
estimating value from repeat use rather than trend status

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While completing a comfortable minimalist outfit around a white T-shirt, [X] settles on slim-fit jeans and compares affordable high-street brands with luxury labels, deciding whether any higher price produces a meaningful gain in fit, finish, and long-term versatility.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 围绕白色 T 恤完善一套舒适的极简穿搭时，[X]已经确定想要修身牛仔裤；接着会在平价大众品牌和奢侈品牌之间比较，判断更高价格是否真的能带来合身度、做工和长期百搭性上的明显提升。
examples: setting a ceiling before trying several brands
accepting a premium for a clearly better fit
rejecting a logo-only price jump

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Before a summer trip to Italy, [X] compares linen shorts from fast-fashion, local, and sustainability-focused retailers, weighing the upfront difference against natural fibers, expected longevity, delivery to Ireland, and possible customs friction.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在意大利夏季旅行前，[X]会比较快时尚、本地零售商和可持续品牌的亚麻短裤，把初始价差与天然面料、预期寿命、寄送爱尔兰的便利性以及可能的关税麻烦一起权衡。
examples: paying more for a durable natural-fiber pair with simple EU delivery
using a certified lower-priced option when the trip budget is tighter
avoiding a nominal bargain after duties erase the saving

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After photographing the tag of a purple tennis skirt in a sports shop, [X] finds the same model online in the needed size and checks whether the displayed GBP 59 markdown from GBP 78 is still available before completing the delayed purchase.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在体育用品店拍下一条紫色网球裙的吊牌后，[X]准备按所需尺码在线购买同款，并在下单前确认吊牌所示的 59 英镑折后价（原价 78 英镑）是否仍然有效。
examples: buying only while the photographed markdown is honored
rechecking the model rather than choosing a different sale item
postponing when the online total no longer matches the expected deal

scenarios.scenario_abstract: With about INR 5,000 available, [X] must cover a school farewell outfit and ticket, summer clothing, and savings for an early-next-month trip; a new lower garment is considered only after those commitments are laid out, with reusing an owned piece remaining a real alternative.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: [X]约有 5,000 印度卢比，需要同时负担学校告别活动服装与门票、夏装，并为下月初的旅行留钱；只有在这些支出排清之后才考虑购入新的裤装或半裙，同时把复用已有单品作为真实备选。
examples: allocating the trip saving before setting the garment ceiling
reusing an owned lower piece when the remaining amount is too small
choosing one versatile purchase instead of several cheap additions

scenarios.scenario_abstract: During a solo July week in Milan on a tight budget, [X] protects food, lodging, and transit money first, then compares sale, outlet, flea-market, and regular retail prices before deciding whether one lower-body piece can fit the remaining shopping allowance.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 计划在七月以紧预算独自游览米兰一周时，[X]会先保住住宿、餐食和交通费用，再比较季末折扣、奥特莱斯、跳蚤市场与常规零售价格，判断剩余购物额度是否足以购买一件裤装或半裙。
examples: setting the fashion allowance after fixed travel costs
waiting for July sales rather than sacrificing meals or transport
choosing vintage or making no purchase when the ceiling is exceeded

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While budgeting with friends for a week at a managed forest campsite, [X] compares buying quick-dry, weather-protective hiking bottoms with borrowing, renting, or sharing other equipment, so the acceptable garment price depends on safety, likely reuse, and the per-person trip total.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 与朋友为在规范森林营地露营一周做预算时，[X]会在购买速干、防风雨的徒步裤装与借用、租赁或共用其他装备之间分配资金；可接受的裤装价格取决于安全需求、未来复用频率和每人的整趟费用。
examples: paying for reliable weather protection while borrowing the tent
renting rarely used gear to preserve the clothing budget
rejecting a premium pair when an adequate option meets the forecast

scenarios.scenario_abstract: [X] wants a stylish college concert outfit but cannot afford new trend-driven clothing, so the options are thrifting or swapping for jeans or refreshing an owned pair with simple patches or embroidery while keeping the ticket and group-travel budget intact.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: [X]想为大学期间的演唱会准备有型穿搭，却负担不起全新的潮流服装，因此会在购买二手牛仔裤、与朋友交换和用简单贴布或刺绣改造已有牛仔裤之间比较，同时不挤占门票和结伴出行预算。
examples: upcycling the owned pair for the lowest cash outlay
buying a distinctive thrifted pair within a hard ceiling
using a clothing swap instead of treating a sale as necessary

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a relaxed Japan trip with an approximate EUR 5,000 total, [X] separates flights, lodging, food, transport, and event tickets before capping spending on statement bottoms so tax-free savings do not consume the emergency or rest-day buffer.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 计划以约 5,000 欧元完成一次节奏放松的日本旅行时，[X]会在东京时尚街区购物前，先分出机票、住宿、餐食、交通和活动门票，再为有设计感的裤装设上限，避免因免税优惠反而吃掉应急金或休息日余量。
examples: reserving the shopping amount before entering fashion districts
comparing vintage and new prices within the same cap
leaving the item when tax-free pricing still exceeds the allowance

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While shopping in central Milan for premium men's wedding formalwear, [X] compares suit tiers ranging roughly from EUR 1,000 to well above EUR 10,000 and judges whether the trousers' fabric, tailoring, alteration service, and fit justify moving beyond the initial premium tier.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在米兰市中心选购高端男士婚礼正装时，[X]会面对约 1,000 欧元起、可超过 10,000 欧元的不同西装档位，并依据西裤面料、剪裁、改衣服务和实际上身效果，判断是否值得超出最初的高端预算层级。
examples: booking fittings before committing to the highest tier
paying more when tailoring solves a real fit problem
choosing a lower premium house when craftsmanship is sufficient
